finding.name: Use After Free
finding.sink_code: printf("completing request %d for fd %d\n", ctx->request_id, ctx->conn->fd);
finding.summary: ctx->conn, a copy of the Connection pointer captured earlier inside a queued CallbackContext, is dereferenced in process_work_queue after connection_release freed and nulled only the caller's own conn variable, leaving the queued copy dangling.
